title: Masked Girl with Crystal Ball
description: A detailed portrait of a young woman with long blue and purple braided hair adorned with stars, flowers, and a crescent moon. She wears a black masquerade mask with a skull design over one eye while holding a glowing purple crystal ball containing an eye; her shoulder features a tattoo of a ringed planet and a geometric staircase with a silhouetted figure ascending.
prompt: A young woman with intricate long blue and purple braids decorated with stars, flowers and a crescent moon, wearing a black lace masquerade mask featuring a white skull over one eye. She holds a glowing purple crystal ball with an eye inside. Her shoulder has a detailed tattoo of a pink ringed planet above a geometric staircase where a black silhouette figure ascends. Surreal fantasy line art style with selective color, intricate patterns, and mystical symbols filling the composition.
